failure.body:
1. Verify that after backend topology deployment, all subintfs are created.
2. 'show subinterface status' should list all the subintfs with the correct speed, mtu, vlan id=10, admin=up and Type=802.1q-encapsulation
3. 'show ip/ipv6 interfaces' should list the newly created subinterfaces with the correct ip/ipv6 address
4. No error msgs should be seen in syslog
